correctness.rationale: The directed 1-WL signature retains old colour and outdegree counts per colour (indegrees determined in tournaments). Independently reconstructed canonical unrooted tournament augmentation by sorted-degree blocks produces 1,1,2,4,12,56,456 classes at orders 1..7, with all 2,4,16,64,384,3584,58368 root-incidence extensions through order 8. Every rooted extension was compared with automorphism orbits, yielding 0 failures through n=7 and exactly two at n=8, with all-outgoing or all-incoming unique root on the same non-vertex-transitive regular seven-tournament. Direct independent automorphism calculation obtains order 3 and orbits 1,3,3 in that tournament; stable colour classes root/others have sizes 1,7. Exhaustiveness is justified by delete-root extension and degree-preserving canonicalization, not by raw output alone.
residual_risks: The fully supplied source-tree listing and exact tree recomputation are not exposed by the connected GitHub fetch_file read action; per-file frozen Git blob SHA identities are verified.
